purpose: Prevent outcome-review detection bias by separating reviewer-visible assets and responses from feature, queue, route, and identity information.
derived_data_rule: Majority, adjudicated, recoded, and model-ready labels are derived analysis artifacts. They must not be inserted into a raw response export or shown to any first-pass reviewer or adjudicator.
leak_disposition_rule: Any detected exposure of a forbidden condition invalidates the affected batch until the exposed records, source, remediation, retest, and final disposition are documented by a non-reviewer.
